inclusions.text: Meet at Cairo International Airport and transfer to hotel
inclusions.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and taken to your hotel.

inclusions.text: Desert safari in 4×4 vehicles with dedicated desert drivers
inclusions.source: After lunch the desert safari begins in 4×4 vehicles, with your dedicated desert drivers.

inclusions.text: Camp in the open desert among the formations, dinner cooked over open fire
inclusions.source: Camp is made in the open desert among the formations, dinner is cooked over open fire, and the night does what no monument can: it gives you the sky the Sahara keeps exceptionally clear.
Your Egyptologist handles Giza; the desert drivers handle the 4×4 stretch from Bahariya into the chalk.
After the visit, the tour transfers you to Cairo International Airport.

inclusions.text: Private departure, operated for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private departure — operated for your party alone, never a shared group.

exclusions.text: Day 3 dinner and evening are your own
exclusions.source: Dinner and the evening are your own.

itinerary.title: Cairo: the arrival
itinerary.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and taken to your hotel.

itinerary.title: West to Bahariya and the White Desert
itinerary.source: Camp is made in the open desert among the formations, dinner is cooked over open fire, and the night does what no monument can: it gives you the sky the Sahara keeps exceptionally clear.

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo: the return drive
itinerary.source: After breakfast in the open you return north to Bahariya Oasis, where the camp facilities allow a shower and a proper lunch, and the drive back to Cairo follows in the afternoon — four hours of desert giving way gradually to the outer suburbs of the capital.

itinerary.title: Giza: the close
itinerary.source: After the visit, the tour transfers you to Cairo International Airport.
